lines.lyric_translation: I know you’re hesitating
Because even if you tell the truth, it’ll come back as scars

lines.lyric: Himeul naeran ppeonhan mareun haji aneul geoya
lines.lyric_hangul: 힘을 내란 뻔한 말은 하지 않을 거야
lines.lyric_translation: I won’t say clichéd things like “have strength”
I’ll just listen to you, listen
What did I tell you?
I told you you’d overcome
You didn’t believe (really)
Will we be able to overcome?
This miracle
Did we make it?
(No) I was always here
You came to me
I do believe your galaxy
I wanna hear your melody
The stars in your Milky Way
How will they appear in your sky?
At the end of my despair
I found you, don’t forget
You’re my last reason
Standing at the edge of a cliff
Live
Days when you hate that you’re you
Days when you wanna disappear

lines.lyric: Muneul hana mandeulja neoye mam sogeda
lines.lyric_hangul: 문을 하나 만들자 너의 맘 속에다
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s make a door in your heart
If you open that door and go inside
This place will be waiting for you

lines.lyric: Mideodo gwaenchana neol wirohaejul magic shop
lines.lyric_hangul: 믿어도 괜찮아 널 위로해줄 Magic Shop
lines.lyric_translation: It’s ok to believe, it’ll comfort you, this Magic Shop
As you drink a cup of warm tea
As you look above to the Milky Way

lines.lyric: Neon gwaenchaneul geoya oh yeogin magic shop
lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 괜찮을 거야 oh 여긴 Magic Shop
lines.lyric_translation: You’ll be alright, oh this is a Magic Shop

Like a rose when blooming
Like a cherry blossom when scattering
Like a lily when withering
Like those beautiful moments
I always wanna be the best
So I was always impatient and anxious
Comparing myself became a daily thing
My greed that used to be a weapon

lines.lyric_hangul: 되려 날 옥죄고 또 목줄이 됐어
lines.lyric_translation: Became a prison and noose

lines.lyric: Geureonde marya dorikyeoboni sashireun marya na
lines.lyric_hangul: 그런데 말야 돌이켜보니 사실은 말야 나
lines.lyric_translation: But looking back, to be honest

lines.lyric: Chwegoga dwego shipeotteon geoshi anin geotman gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 최고가 되고 싶었던 것이 아닌 것만 같아
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t think I wanted to be the best
I wanted to be someone’s comfort / I wanted to touch someone’s heart

lines.lyric: Geudaeye seulpeum apeum geodweogago shipeo na
lines.lyric_hangul: 그대의 슬픔 아픔 거둬가고 싶어 나
lines.lyric_translation: I want to take away your sadness, your pain
Days when you hate that you’re you
Days when you wanna disappear
